'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Houthi–Saudi Arabian conflict]]
**A [[Houthi movement|Houthi]] [[drone strike]] on a [[Saudi Aramco]] [[oil refinery]] in the capital [[Riyadh]] causes a large fire. The Houthis say that they launched six [[unmanned combat aerial vehicle|drones]] at a Saudi Aramco facility and vow to continue operations against Saudi Arabia as long as its aggression against [[Yemen]] continues. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/3/19/fire-at-saudi-arabia-oil-facility-after-drone-attack (Al Jazeera)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Volcanism in Iceland]]
**[[Geldingadalir eruption|A volcano erupts]] south of ​[[Fagradalsfjall]] in [[Reykjanes]], southwestern [[Iceland]], according to the [[Icelandic Meteorological Office|Meteorological Office]]. The eruption follows 40,000 [[list of earthquakes in Iceland|earthquakes]] detected in the last month.  [https://icelandmonitor.mbl.is/news/news/2021/03/19/eruption_has_started_in_fagradalsfjall/ (Iceland Monitor)] [https://www.mirror.co.uk/news/world-news/breaking-iceland-volcano-starts-erupt-23762608 (''Daily Mirror'')] [https://www.mbl.is/frettir/innlent/2021/03/19/upptok_gossins_eru_i_geldingadal/ (''Morgunblaðið'')]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in the Philippines]]
*****The [[Food and Drug Administration (Philippines)|Food and Drug Administration]] approves the emergency use of the [[Russia]]n [[Sputnik V COVID-19 vaccine|Sputnik V]] [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]]. [https://www.rappler.com/nation/philippines-gives-emergency-approval-russia-sputnik-covid-19-vaccine (Rappler)]
****The [[Philippines]] reports a record 7,103 new confirmed cases in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 648,066. [https://news.abs-cbn.com/news/03/19/21/highest-ever-ph-reports-record-high-7103-new-covid-19-cases (ABS-CBN News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]]
****[[India]] reports 39,670 new cases in the past 24 hours, the highest single-day total since November 28, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 11.5 million. [https://m.timesofindia.com/india/india-sees-sharpest-5-day-rise-in-covid-cases-in-10-months/amp_articleshow/81578107.cms (''The Times of India'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Nepal]]
****[[Nepal]] grants emergency use authorization for the [[India]]n [[Covaxin]] [[COVID-19]] [[vaccine]], becoming the third country to do so. [https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/nepal-becomes-3rd-country-to-give-emergency-nod-to-covaxin-101616168087407.html (''Hindustan Times'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in France]]
****The [[France|French]] National Authority for Health limits the use of the [[Oxford-AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|Oxford-AstraZeneca]] vaccine to those aged over 55 years old after it was discovered that three patients who suffered [[blood clot]]s are younger than 55 years old. [https://www.nytimes.com/2021/03/19/world/france-resumes-use-of-astrazenecas-vaccine-for-those-over-55-and-the-prime-minister-gets-the-shot.html (''The New York Times'')]
****[[Prime Minister of France|Prime Minister]] [[Jean Castex]] receives his first dose of the Oxford-AstraZeneca vaccine. [https://www.france24.com/en/france/20210319-french-pm-castex-to-get-astrazeneca-shot-in-bid-to-restore-public-confidence (France 24)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****[[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|Prime Minister]] [[Boris Johnson]] receives his first dose of the [[Oxford-AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|Oxford-AstraZeneca]] [[vaccine]]. [https://news.sky.com/story/covid-19-boris-johnson-receives-first-dose-of-oxford-astrazeneca-vaccine-12249467 (Sky News)]
****The [[United Kingdom]] reports a new single-day total of 660,276 doses of the vaccine administered. [https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2021-03-19/uk-reports-new-daily-vaccine-record-with-660-276-shots (U.S. News and World Report)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Finland]]
****[[Finland]] suspends the use of the [[Oxford-AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|Oxford-AstraZeneca]] vaccine after reporting two cases of unusual [[blood clot]]ting in the [[brain]] in vaccinated people. [https://yle.fi/uutiset/osasto/news/finland_suspends_astrazeneca_covid_vaccinations/11847438 (Yle)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Georgia (country)|COVID-19 pandemic in Georgia]]
****A 27-year-old nurse dies in [[Akhaltsikhe]], [[Georgia (country)|Georgia]], from presumed [[anaphylactic shock]] following an [[Oxford-AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|Oxford-AstraZeneca]] vaccine jab. [https://www.rferl.org/a/georgia-astrazeneca-nurse-death-vaccine/31159516.html (RFE/RL)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Germany]]
****[[Germany]] resumes its use of the [[Oxford-AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|Oxford-AstraZeneca]] vaccine after the [[European Medicines Agency]] declares it to be safe and not associated with an increased risk of [[blood clot]]s. [https://www.latimes.com/world-nation/story/2021-03-19/astrazeneca-covid-vaccinations-resume-germany-after-blood-clot-scare (''The Los Angeles Times'')] 
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Hungary]]
****[[Hungary]] reports a record 213 deaths and 10,759 new confirmed cases of [[COVID-19]] in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 17,841 and the nationwide case total to 549,839. [https://hungarytoday.hu/daily-coronavirus-update-friday-fatalities-patients-ventilators-record/ (Hungary Today)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Poland]]
****[[Poland]] surpasses two million cases of COVID-19. [https://www.dailysabah.com/world/europe/polands-covid-19-cases-pass-2-million-boosted-by-new-mutation (''Daily Sabah'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Africa]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Kenya]]
****[[Kenya]] reports a record 28 deaths in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 1,982. [https://nation.africa/kenya/news/kenya-s-daily-covid-19-deaths-reach-all-time-high-of-28-3328504 (Nation)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Seychelles]]
****[[Seychelles]] approves the emergency use of the [[Russia]]n [[Sputnik V COVID-19 vaccine|Sputnik V]] COVID-19 vaccine. [https://www.urdupoint.com/en/amp/world/seychelles-registers-russian-covid-19-vaccine-1199006.html (UrduPoint)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Mississippi]], [[501.V2 variant]]
****[[Mississippi]] reports its first case of the 501.V2 variant, which was originally detected in [[South Africa]], in a person in [[Harrison County, Mississippi|Harrison County]]. [https://mississippitoday.org/2021/03/19/vaccine-resistant-covid-19-strain-detected-in-mississippi/ (Mississippi Today)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil]]
***[[Brazil]] reports a record 90,570 new confirmed cases from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 11,871,390. [https://riotimesonline.com/brazil-news/miscellaneous/covid-19/covid-19-brazil-records-2815-deaths-and-90-5-thousand-new-cases-march-19th/ (''The Rio Times'')]

**The [[United States House of Representatives]] votes 398–14 on a resolution to condemn the [[2021 Myanmar coup d'état|military coup]] in [[Myanmar]]. [https://www.urdupoint.com/en/world/us-house-passes-resolution-condemning-militar-1199255.html (UrduPoint)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[The Troubles]]
**The head of the [[Loyalist Communities Council]], [[David Campbell (Northern Ireland politician, born 1965)|David Campbell]], says that the 1998 [[Good Friday Agreement]] is under threat under the current conditions of [[Brexit]] and [[Northern Ireland]]. Campbell warns that it could unleash a "political crisis" and says that the [[Northern Irish Protocol]] breaches the 1998 accord. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-britain-eu-nireland/northern-irelands-peace-deal-under-threat-unless-eu-changes-brexit-deal-loyalists-warn-idUSKBN2BB1AQ?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[President of Belarus|Belarusian President]] [[Alexander Lukashenko]] names former [[Ministry of Internal Affairs (Belarus)|Interior Minister]] [[Yury Karayeu]] and Health Minister Vladimir Karanik as possible successors to lead the [[Belarus|country]]. [https://tass.com/world/1268175 (TASS)]
